# Design System Component Contracts

<!-- Generated by design-system/scripts/generate-contract-docs.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

- Version: `1.1.0`
- Schema: `2026-06-14-token-driven-contracts`
- Scope: cross-platform web/ios

## Mandatory Surfaces

### Shared Primitives

- `app-shell`
- `card`
- `badge`
- `button`
- `navigation`

### Screens

- `screen.feed`
- `screen.messages`
- `screen.myPage`

## Global Rules

- `All platform implementations must use canonical tokens for color/spacing/radius/typography/radius/elevation values.`
- `No inline hardcoded style tokens are allowed in core surface containers without a documented exception in migration evidence.`
- `Interaction states must be consistent: default / hover / press / focus / disabled / loading / empty / error where applicable.`
- `Safe-area and platform form-factor differences are allowed only at the container and navigation level.`

## Violation Rules

### `raw-color-literal`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Core implementation evidence must not introduce raw hex/rgb/hsl/named semantic platform colors instead of DS color tokens.
- Machine detection: `webPatterns, iosPatterns`

### `raw-spacing-or-sizing-scalar`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Layout, spacing, radius, dimensions, and opacity in covered contracts must resolve to design tokens or approved token classes.
- Machine detection: `webPatterns, iosPatterns`

### `raw-typography`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Typography in covered contracts must use DS text styles, generated font tokens, or approved token-backed web classes.
- Machine detection: `webPatterns, iosPatterns`

### `missing-token-family-evidence`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Every required token family and explicit requiredTokenUsage entry must be present in implementation evidence for screen contracts.
- Machine detection: `source`

### `missing-contract-evidence`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Mandatory screen contracts must declare readable implementationEvidence files for every supported platform.
- Machine detection: `source`

## Evidence Requirements

- mandatoryScreens: Each mandatory screen contract must list implementationEvidence.web and implementationEvidence.ios files that are readable from the repository root.
- tokenFamilies: Evidence files must contain every token family listed in requiredTokenFamilies, using platform-appropriate generated tokens or token-backed class names.
- explicitTokenUsage: Evidence files must contain every token reference listed in requiredTokenUsage unless the contract declares a documented exception.
- violationReporting: Verifier output must name the contract, platform, violated rule, and source pattern or missing token reference.
- documentation: Run npm run generate-contract-docs after contract changes; generated docs must describe required surfaces, violation rules, evidence requirements, and per-contract token expectations.
